reason: In public/app/features/alerting/unified/components/rule-viewer/AlertRuleMenu.tsx, canPause and canDelete are ORed from ruler and Grafana Prom abilities (lines 83, 87), but Pause still requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (line 123) and Delete still requires `rulerRule` (line 165). The list view passes only promRule (rule-list/GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:47 → RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:95 `rulerRule={rule}` is undefined), so neither item can render for Grafana rules there.
